title: 0riggin.mods
description: Optimization & Utility modpack for vanila SMP's
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9720cdceaca43fd4f20e61e05a88f515cfc4fe6d_0.webp)
***

**EN**:
This modpack is created for my friends and my vanilla server on minecraft.
EN:A modpack optimized for survival on vanilla SMP servers.

<details> <summary>Includes the following mods:</summary>
Performance Optimization:

    Krypton
    StutterFix
    Fabric API
    Sodium
    Lithium
    Sodium Extra
    ModernFix
    More Culling
    Entity Culling

Interface and Enhancements:

    Mod Menu
    MaLiLib
    Cloth Config API
    YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)
    Default Dark Mode
    Unique Dark
    Zoomify
    Dynamic FPS
    Blur+

Functionality:

    Plasmo Voice
    Sound Physics Remastered
    NightVision
    Inventory Profiles Next
    Chest Tracker
    Litematica
    Chat Binds
    RP Renames
    Skin Shuffle

Visual Improvements:

    Iris Shaders
    Ears (adds unique visual elements for skins)
    3D Skin Layers
    Fancy Crops

Texture Mods:

    CIT Resewn
    CIT Enchanted Books: Hotfix
    [ETF] Entity Texture Features

</details> 

***
